and (buyercode like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or buyersimple like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or buyerfull like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or contactperson like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or mobile like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) order by createtime desc, buyercode desc limit #{limit}
